proofLimits: Four real-time public browser journeys are separate from the 64 closed mechanics/audio/VM checks, which are not repeated.
Eighteen anonymous before/after observations bind eight source payloads; root and index.html share the same HTML.
Native Chromium controls, interruptions, storage, touch and rendered canvas are observed without private application state or a synthetic animation clock.

D01 uses a fresh owned Chromium/default context over public noDefaults CDP; normal Browser.close must release the actual child. Nested Chrome diagnostics retain complete sanitized bytes, with original observed counts/digests recorded separately; original bytes are not archived or independently replayable.
Headed Chromium uses owned Xvfb/auth storage. Selected X11 socket/lock absence is observed separately; unknown external resources are never removed.

Only Playwright1.64.1 and its headed Chromium are installed in owned runner storage. Existing shared libraries, Xvfb, xauth and fonts are recorded; missing requirements fail without privileged package installation.
Exit/close/EOF/groups and same-UID owned browser/Xvfb paths plus Linux starttime prove scoped cleanup, not a host-wide inventory.
Deployment ID is a parent-supplied metadata label; served bytes do not independently fetch provider metadata or identify an internal backend.
Canvas crops and actual UI do not prove physical devices, speaker output, audio latency, scientific flight accuracy or complete product acceptance.

proofLimits: All flight progression uses real wall time and the actual animation loop; no clock installation, model import, state/score injection or DOM event synthesis.
Headed Chromium under owned Xvfb exercises real keyboard, native tab focus/visibility and emulated touch. This is not a physical touchscreen, audible-output or performance acceptance claim.
Only authored corruption of this app key and an unrelated authored sentinel are written as negative/setup data; no completed score or preference API is replaced.

D01 uses an independently spawned owned Chromium/default context over public noDefaults CDP; the other cases use two Playwright-managed browsers. D04 rejects a profile that still exposes usable localStorage.
Two small DOM screenshot crops are retained for visual inspection; pixel statistics establish drawing, not full viewport appearance or a flight-simulation certification.
The outer controller independently binds hosted assets/source and verifies attributable browser/Xvfb processes before deleting its scratch.

ownedChrome.profileRemoval: delegated to outer owned-root cleanup after process verification

ownedChromeDiagnostics.qualification: Retained sanitized bytes were independently decompressed and hashed. Original observed digests are recorded but cannot be replayed without the unarchived original bytes.

networkCleanup.basis: Public asset streams cancelled and reader locks released; no host-wide socket inventory.

browserProcessCleanup.basis: Same UID, unique owned-root argv attribution and revalidated Linux kernel PID starttime; no argv/env output.

x11Cleanup.basis: Actual owned-auth Xvfb display; socket/lock were absent before launch and are absent after normal wrapper teardown. No external resource is deleted.

xvfbDiagnostics.source: Owned regular file for xvfb-run/Xvfb stderr; no authentication-file contents are read.
xvfbDiagnostics.closureBasis: Wrapper exit/close/pipe EOF and original group absence, plus independently verified owned browser/Xvfb process absence.
